A [[Gender/Legends|male]] '''weapons smuggler''' was active during the [[Galactic Civil War/Legends|Galactic Civil War]]. The [[Smuggler/Legends|smuggler]] managed to run afoul of both the [[Alliance to Restore the Republic/Legends|Rebel Alliance]] and another individual while running weapons into an [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] controlled [[Sector/Legends|sector]].

Some years before [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]]<ref name="Date">''[[The New Essential Chronology]]'' dates the events of ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II]]''&mdash;during which [[Kyle Katarn]] [[Death/Legends|kills]] the [[Gran]] on [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], according to ''[[Star Wars: Jedi Knight: Dark Forces II: The Official Strategy Guide]]''&mdash;to [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], whereas the Gran himself speaks about their meeting happening "a few years back" in the [[Dark Forces: Rebel Agent (audio drama)|''Dark Forces: Rebel Agent'' audio drama]].</ref> the Alliance sent [[Agent/Legends|agent]] [[Kyle Katarn]] to handle the smuggler's operation, while the individual sent his [[Gran/Legends|Gran]] [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]] to deal with the smuggler. Katarn and [[Unidentified Gran (Rimmer's Rest)|the Gran]] eventually crossed paths, and after a presumed misunderstanding of the others goals, they engaged in a [[Lightfight|firefight]] that left the Gran with a [[Blaster/Legends|blaster]] injury in his [[Limb/Legends|leg]]. Katarn disposed of the smuggler's operation soon after. Later during [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the Gran and Katarn encountered each other again on the [[Moon/Legends|moon]] [[Nar Shaddaa/Legends|Nar Shaddaa]], where the Gran inquired whether or not Katarn remembered their past encounter. Katarn didn't remember their encounter at all, however.
